name: NICE Information Service Co., Ltd.
summary: NICE Information Service Co., Ltd. provides credit evaluation, credit inquiries, credit investigations, and debt collection services in South Korea. The company offers credit and corporate information and consulting services. It also offers management consulting and data analysis services. In addition, the company provides construction and development related services. NICE Information Service Co., Ltd. was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
